messages:
mira: Notifying folks: we're seeing intermittent 502s from private deploys in apac-2 since ~10:05 UTC. Impacting a handful of enterprise customers.
devon: Looking at gateway logs now. 502s correlate with connection timeouts to the inference runtime pool.
ravi: I see a pattern: runtime processes hitting ephemeral-ssd I/O wait spikes after a nightly snapshot job.
mira: Paging oncall. @oncall-bot please create incident.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-5510 created and routed to infra-oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-5510
devon: Short term mitigation: routing rule added to avoid apac-2 for dedicated /private deployments (smart-routing policy applied). Traffic shifted ~65% away.
eng-ops: We disabled the nightly snapshot in apac-2 (infra flag: snapshot.enabled=false) while we investigate.
ravi: Confirmed: disabling snapshot removed the I/O spikes on affected hosts. 502 rate down to ~0.5% from 7%.
mira: Status page update please.
status-bot: Status page: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/PD-5510 - "Partial outage: APAC private deployments; mitigation in progress"
devon: Follow-ups: 1) move snapshot job to staggered schedule 2) investigate ephemeral-ssd throughput and adjust IO scheduler 3) add runtime healthcheck for IO wait
ravi: Filing tickets: INF-7950 (stagger snapshots), INF-7951 (storage perf), INF-7952 (healthcheck)
mira: CS and affected customers notified. We'll keep traffic routed off apac-2 until next maintenance window.
oncall-bot: Incident PD-5510 status: mitigated -> monitoring
mira: Postmortem draft ETA 3h. Thanks for the quick response team.
